author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-58115: Actively exploited RCE in Node-RED (Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050), CVSS 10.0. Missing-authentication flaw lets unauthenticated remote attackers execute arbitrary system commands on exposed hosts.

author: morphisec
text: F5 BIG-IP APM Zero-Day (CVE-2026-94127) Actively Exploited — 14,700+ instances exposed, CISA KEV added. Unauthenticated RCE in BIG-IP APM's OAuth.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS): active exploitation confirmed of CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. Apply Ivanti's October 29 security patches immediately on an emergency basis.

author: ido_cohen2
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-46300 actively exploited in the wild; missing initialization flaw allows root-level access. Not linked to ransomware yet.

author: morphisec
text: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks, CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 (both CVSS 9.5); shellcode placed directly into memory.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell), CVSS v4.0 9.2, actively exploited unauthenticated RCE flaws in PHP core. CISA added CVE-2026-109618 to KEV on 26 October 2026.

author: binarly_io
text: Pre-Auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 exploited in the wild as a zero-day, linked to CVE-2026-7273 (KEV), but the patch did not stop the exploit.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical zero-click Android RCE patched, CVE-2026-58868: heap buffer overflow in Android Framework (FrameDecoder.cpp onOutputReceived) allows RCE without user interaction.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to actively exploited RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0): unauthenticated code execution via malicious regex in CI/CD configuration.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-119977: WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition actively exploited; CISA added it to KEV on November 3, 2026.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited Cisco ASA/FTD VPN flaw CVE-2026-76418 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker force a reload (DoS) when SSL remote-access VPN is reachable.

author: iamspiggle
text: Linux Kernel CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) TCP/MPTCP use-after-free: unauthenticated remote root code execution demonstrated via automated exploits; also CVE-2026-46300.

author: HacktronAI
text: A critical vulnerability went undetected through multiple security audits; Hacktron's AI found it in 10 minutes in Dassault Systemes DELMIA Apriso (used by Boeing, Airbus, Lockheed Martin). It became CVE-2025-5086.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SonicWall GMS vulnerability CVE-2026-109593 exposes internal files without authentication.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical SolarWinds Dameware command injection CVE-2026-28336 (CVSS 9.9) could allow attackers to compromise remote systems.

author: morphisec
text: CISA: ransomware gangs now exploiting critical JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass CVE-2026-63077; KEV updated.

author: morphisec
text: Carbonato botnet installs the Hermes AI agent on hijacked Docker hosts; worm-like botnet scans for unauthenticated Docker APIs on port 2375.

author: abhiunix
text: CVE-2026-118306, a critical Chrome sandbox escape fixed 27 Oct; Playwright 1.64.1 used by AI agents still ships the old Chromium with sandbox off by default.

author: stretchcloud
text: Playwright 1.64.1 ships early Chromium 156 carrying four live CVEs (CVE-2026-118306, CVE-2026-118331, CVE-2026-118348, CVE-2026-118344) with sandbox off by default; risk for AI browsing agents.

author: OpenMatter_
text: A contractor reportedly ran a personal AI agent on a Pentagon network for two months, and a tampered Claude Code add-on spent 11 hours in Cursor's store.

author: loyndsview
text: An Accenture employee's AI agent ran on the DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability patched.

author: cybersec24h
text: AI agent platform Trigger.dev says an attacker accessed environment variables (where apps keep API keys) for a subset of organizations; exploit blocked, affected owners emailed. Rotate secrets.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: LLMjacking becoming a full-scale cybercriminal business: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant found criminals hijacking cloud AI access with stolen keys and reselling it; charges up to $1M at some victims.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Stolen cloud keys fuel LLMjacking (Mandiant); Kaspersky tracks CyberStrikeAI; Chainlit and AWS MCP have path traversal flaws. Rotate keys, validate MCP paths.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: OPSSHIELD says unauthorized access to cPGuard's update CDN let an attacker push a malicious script on Nov 2. Check versions 5.88.12-5.88.19, update to 5.88.25+, rotate DB and cloud keys.

author: NamanyayG
text: Oct 21: Railway detected attackers in systems storing customer secrets, told every user to rotate keys. 12 days later Railway is back in the news after its AI agents were let loose on someone else's site.

author: joshmanders
text: Attackers pulled credentials from inside their app's container and used them to request every secret on the platform, and tried the cloud metadata endpoint to steal host credentials.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: Hackers use ARTEX AI tool to automate enterprise attacks at machine speed: AI-powered offensive framework moves from stolen credentials to cloud privilege escalation, lateral movement and data theft in minutes.

author: Python_s_
text: Kaspersky confirms CyberStrikeAI-driven intrusions and domain compromise at educational organizations; open-source AI pentest and C2 framework abused in real attacks.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Password manager mSecure is warning current and former customers to secure credentials stored in its application following suspicious activity.

author: zhang420520
text: Binance post-mortem on the Oct 29 heist: began in June when an engineer downloaded a tampered AI coding tool via a sponsored Google link (supply chain attack).

author: TonTraderCom
text: Hackers ran $100K of AI services using stolen API keys; at least nine developer platforms targeted in October, abusing access to OpenAI, Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock.

author: num1_ch
text: GitHub reported a vulnerability linked to AI agents, urging users to change their login credentials.
